newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen opening higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen opening higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open higher on Tuesday, with analysts saying there is nothing to stop the Dow Jones industrial average from pursuing its two-day run into record territory.

"We're probably heading for a slightly higher opening," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments. "With the absence of economic data we'll probably make a stab at another level."
The Dow topped the 7,500 level for the first time on Monday before pulling back, closing unofficially up 43 at 7,479.
